allocations_kind_check.name: allocations_kind_check
allocations_kind_check.value: ("allocations"."kind" = 'apply' and "allocations"."reverses_allocation_id" is null) or ("allocations"."kind" = 'reverse' and "allocations"."reverses_allocation_id" is not null)

documents_supply_type_check.name: documents_supply_type_check
documents_supply_type_check.value: "documents"."type" not in ('invoice', 'bill', 'creditNote', 'debitNote') or "documents"."intra_state" is not null

documents_advance_supply_check.name: documents_advance_supply_check
documents_advance_supply_check.value: case when "documents"."type" = 'receipt' and "documents"."settlement_kind" = 'advance' then "documents"."advance_supply" is not null when "documents"."type" = 'receipt' and "documents"."settlement_kind" = 'against' then true else "documents"."advance_supply" is null end
